This is a list of Pokémon that are available in [[Pokémon Champions]]. 208 Pokémon species are available in the game, as well as 76 [[Mega Evolution]]s.

Functionally distinct, permanent [[form]]s (such as [[regional form]]s) are listed alongside the base forms of their respective species, while other forms (such as [[Mega Evolution]]s) are listed in separate sections below.

Until September 2, 2026, the current roster is Regular Roster M-B. Pokémon not in the current roster cannot be obtained without the use of events or [[transfer]]ring them from another game.

==List of Pokémon in Champions==
Eternal Flower Floette is allowed under the current regulation, but it must be transferred from {{pkmn|Legends: Z-A}} through {{pkmn|HOME}}.

==Trivia==
* Some Pokémon were not present in the game at release, despite being shown in promotional material or artwork related to {{g|Champions}}:
** {{p|Metagross}}, {{p|Ursaluna}}, {{p|Dondozo}}, {{p|Tatsugiri}}, and {{me|Raichu}} X were shown in promotional material.
** Mega Raichu Y and Mega {{p|Zygarde}} were shown on the official art for the 2026 Japan Championships, which was played on Pokémon Champions.
** {{p|Salamence}} is featured on the first splash screen.
*** Excluding {{pkmn2|Legendary}} and [[Mythical Pokémon]], Mega Salamence is the only Mega Evolution introduced in [[Generation VI]] that is not present in Pokémon Champions.
** {{p|Pawmot}} is featured on the "Battle" icon on the menu (unlike the others, however, it is present in the game's code, but it is not playable).
* No {{pkmn2|Legendary}} or [[Mythical Pokémon]] are present in the game<!-- at launch-->.
** Mega {{p|Zygarde}} is the only Mega Evolution introduced in the base game of {{g|Legends: Z-A}} to not be present in Pokémon Champions.
* Some Pokémon in the game<!-- at launch--> have unique distinctions:
** {{p|Pikachu}} is the only Pokémon present in the game<!-- at launch--> that is capable of [[Evolution]].
** {{p|Qwilfish}} is <!--currently -->the only Pokémon present in the game which has a [[regional form]] that is not present in the game.
** {{p|Castform}} is the only Pokémon present in the game<!-- at launch--> that does not appear in any [[Generation IX]] [[core series]] games.
